items.heading: A Handful of Sectors Treat
items.text: A handful of sectors treat a foreign degree, especially from a globally recognised university, as a real and active hiring filter, not just a nice-to-have line on a resume.

items.heading: Outside Those Specific Pockets, Most
items.text: Outside those specific pockets, most hiring in India runs on a very different logic. If you are applying to domestic corporate roles, IT services companies, most sales and operations functions, government-linked recruitment, or small and mid-size businesses, the degree's country of origin has limited effect on the outcome once you clear the basic education-requirement filter.
